run_summary.failure_reason: web template is incomplete: expected frontend/ and backend/ directories

confirmed_facts: main.py was executed with the runner's generation arguments; the runner spec used /workspace/tests and recorded zero bundled-test fallback hits.
Environment preflight and dependency installation completed; the generation agent was launched with MODEL=deepseek-v4-flash and masked OPENAI_API_KEY=set.
The generation-side probe repeatedly returned HTTP 401 Unauthorized, and later driver errors were recorded as invalid_api_key; the log never exposes the secret value.
Four skeleton attempts failed; each recorded tools=0, wrote=False and verified=False, so no generation attempt produced a verified web skeleton.
The generation flow aborted with RuntimeError: skeleton scaffolding failed: no frontend/ and backend/ after 4 attempts.
Postflight listed the workspace and warned that no frontend/ and backend/ existed anywhere; the runner then rejected the template as incomplete.
The final platform result was FAILED with score 0 and no tests executed; application_server_started=false and playwright_tests_executed=false.
The final template ZIP has 25 entries and contains requirements plus reference images, but zero frontend/ entries and zero backend/ entries.
Meter baseline login also returned a masked 401 observation, and no token, provider-total or cost metric was captured.
No current-Run snapshots file was present in the supplied evidence folder; therefore no generated business implementation or design/codegen snapshot can be diagnosed.

failure_chain.result: 21 probe attempts over approximately 10 minutes returned HTTP 401 Unauthorized; the agent proceeded after the endpoint was still failing
skeleton attempts 1 through 4 each failed after repeated driver authentication errors; tools=0, wrote=False, verified=False
generation aborted because frontend/ and backend/ were absent after four attempts
runner failed before starting the application server or Playwright: web template is incomplete

internal_acceptance_vs_platform.internal_acceptance: none; generation aborted before a web template existed
internal_acceptance_vs_platform.interpretation: There is no internal or platform business-test result to compare. The 0/0 platform value reflects a pre-test template gate, not a measured application feature rate.

root_cause_candidates.issue: Generation model requests were rejected by the configured API route with HTTP 401 invalid_api_key
evidence: Probe attempts 1 through 21 returned HTTP 401 Unauthorized.
Driver retries recorded authentication failed for openai@127/deepseek-v4-flash and invalid_api_key.
The environment exposed only OPENAI_API_KEY=set(len=9); no secret value was logged.
The separate meter baseline login also returned 401, but that does not by itself prove the generation request and meter failure share one credential cause.
root_cause_candidates.boundary: Confirmed that authentication failure was observed and blocked generation; not confirmed whether the underlying cause was an expired/invalid key, account scope, provider routing, platform credential binding, or a transient platform-side auth state.

root_cause_candidates.issue: After deterministic authentication failures, the generation flow spent four skeleton attempts without producing a fallback or verified minimal skeleton
evidence: All four attempts report tools=0, wrote=False, verified=False.
The flow continued through repeated retries and then aborted on missing frontend/backend directories.
The postflight workspace contains requirements, references and traceability artifacts but no web application directories.
root_cause_candidates.boundary: This confirms the observed orchestration behavior; it does not yet prove which Agent code path or policy decision is responsible without inspecting the submitted source and reproducing with a controlled endpoint.

root_cause_candidates.issue: The platform runner rejected the incomplete web template before application/test execution
evidence: Platform failure_reason is web template is incomplete: expected frontend/ and backend/ directories.
Postflight warns no frontend/+backend/ found anywhere.
The final template ZIP contains zero frontend/ and zero backend/ entries.
Application server and Playwright were never started.
root_cause_candidates.boundary: This is a confirmed downstream rejection, not an independent root cause of why model generation failed.

root_cause_candidates.issue: Retry policy may be spending substantial time on an authentication error that is unlikely to recover within the same run
evidence: The probe waited about 10 minutes and made 21 unsuccessful attempts before continuing.
Four skeleton attempts then repeated driver authentication retries, and the total run duration reached 1095 seconds.
No attempt wrote or verified a skeleton.
root_cause_candidates.boundary: The exact savings and the correct retry policy require a controlled reproduction; do not change retry behavior solely from this Run in the phase 4 session.

excluded_causes: Not a missing entrypoint: main.py was invoked by the runner.
Not a bundled-test fallback: /workspace/tests was present in the runner spec and bundled fallback hits were zero.
Not a Playwright test failure: no application server or Playwright execution started.
Not a business implementation defect that can be diagnosed from this Run: no frontend/backend application was generated.
Not an observed plaintext API-key leak: logs show only masked environment state and the manifest records zero plaintext hits.
Not primarily an out-of-memory failure: the log records memory usage below the 2048 MiB cgroup limit and oom_kill=0; the visible failure is authentication followed by missing output directories.
Not a platform test-suite result: the runner rejected the template before any test could run.
evidence_gaps: The exact source of the 401 remains unresolved: credential validity, account entitlement, provider route, model authorization and platform-side credential binding cannot be distinguished from this Run alone.
No provider token totals, request count or cost were captured because metering authentication failed and generation did not complete.
No task snapshot ID, agent build ID, code SHA or platform-provided ZIP-to-build binding was supplied.
No current-Run snapshots JSON, generated source tree, standalone Playwright report or error-context body is available; the absence is expected after pre-test generation abort.
The final ZIP proves the submitted template package lacked frontend/backend, but cannot identify the precise Agent source function that failed to create them without source inspection.

minimal_read_only_reproduction_experimen.purpose: Separate credential/route failure from application-generation logic
steps: Using the same model, base URL and execution profile, perform one redacted authentication preflight; record only status code and provider error class, never the key.
Check generation endpoint authentication separately from meter login authentication.
Do not create a platform Run during this phase.
minimal_read_only_reproduction_experimen.success_criterion: A controlled authorized request succeeds, or the responsible credential/route boundary is identified without exposing a secret.

minimal_read_only_reproduction_experimen.purpose: Test whether main.py can create the required skeleton independently of live model availability
steps: Run the existing entrypoint in an isolated local harness with a deterministic mocked model response or recorded non-secret fixture.
Check whether frontend/ and backend/ are created and whether the agent marks the result verified.
Do not modify official tests or the current platform submission.
minimal_read_only_reproduction_experimen.success_criterion: The agent creates both required directories and a minimal valid skeleton under a controlled successful model response.

minimal_read_only_reproduction_experimen.purpose: Measure fail-fast/retry behavior without spending another platform run
steps: Feed a deterministic 401 response to the isolated generation driver.
Record probe count, retry count, elapsed time and whether any files are written.
Compare with a deterministic successful response.
minimal_read_only_reproduction_experimen.success_criterion: The retry boundary and safe early-abort behavior are known before considering any platform rerun.

actions: First validate the authorized model endpoint, model entitlement and meter authentication path with redacted observations.
Inspect the existing Agent generation path to ensure a successful model response writes frontend/ and backend/ and that a deterministic 401 is classified separately from transient errors.
Consider a bounded fail-fast policy for repeated 401 errors to avoid the observed 10-minute probe plus repeated skeleton retries; quantify with an isolated reproduction first.
Do not infer or implement Keep business-feature fixes from this Run; no application was generated and no business test ran.
Only after authentication and skeleton generation are verified should a new platform Run be considered; that action is outside this phase.
